en.answer:
When your opponent activates <<11268>>, you can chain the effect of <<12950>>. (Whether or not you control any monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck does not matter.)

Similarly, <<12950>>'s effect can also always respond to any of the following:
● <<21362>>
● <<17066>>
● <<14188>>
● <<16481>>
● <<11843>>
● <<13482>>
● <<12859>>
● <<14304>>
● <<11840>>
● <<20934>>
● <<16873>>
● <<17188>>
en.question: When my opponent activates <<11268>>, can I chain the effect of <<12950>> from my hand?
